in_sanskrit.name: भीमा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who inspires fear, awe, or terror. A powerful and mighty figure.

in_hindi.name: भीम
in_hindi.long_meaning: भीमा (Bhīmā) - भीम (Bhīm) is a name that evokes fear and awe. It is the name of one of the Pandava brothers in Hindu mythology, known for his immense strength and fearlessness.

in_tamil.name: பீமம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: பீமம் (Pīmam) is a name that conveys a sense of power and might. It is derived from the Sanskrit word भीम (bhīm), meaning 'terrifying, fear-inspiring'.

in_telugu.name: బీమ
in_telugu.long_meaning: బీమ (Bīm) is a name that signifies strength and fearlessness. It is the name of one of the Pandava brothers in Hindu mythology and is derived from the Sanskrit word भीम (bhīm), meaning 'terrifying, fear-inspiring'.

in_marathi.name: Bheema
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bheema हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bheema is a powerful and strong character in Hindu mythology, known for his immense strength and intelligence. In the epic Mahabharata, he is the elder brother of the Pandava brothers and an ally of Yudhishthira, the righteous eldest brother.
